reviews.text: We've had a pool for over 30 years and have used numerous pool servicers. Poolsmith has been our favorite. We've been using them for around 10 years now. They offer consistent knowledge, our pool is always clean, operates efficiently, and their techs are always friendly. Our dogs always have to go say hello, and they are met with kindness. We highly recommend Will Smith and his guys!
reviews.author: Lori Kolbye

reviews.text: I loved my former pool company which relocated to FL but they directed me to Premium Poolsmith. I could not be more pleased. Professional in every aspect.  When I had an issue and sent an email they responded in 2 minutes with the perfect response.  Clearly very knowledgeable and competent. I can't imagine ever using another company. That is unless they move to FL.
reviews.author: Jonathan Holmes

reviews.text: This company is amazing.  I was on vacation and needed my pool timer repaired. I messaged them Monday around 0800.  They called me back within 15 minutes and setup a tech to check it out.  Great communication from beginning to end.  Repair was done before noon that day.
reviews.author: James Bass

reviews.text: Premium Poolsmith takes care of my pool weekly, maintain the filters and cleaning system, make any repairs that are needed, and do any excellent job. I have used several companies and I changed to Premium Poolsmith several years ago which was a great decision on my part. I highly recommend them.
reviews.author: Jimmie Blackwood
